user.title: Add link — select how it actuates the zone
user.description:
How should the Home Assistant source sensor actuate the Satel zone?

• Continuously — breached sensor violates the zone and always triggers an alarm, even when the partition is disarmed. Best for monitoring heat / smoke / gas / moisture hazards.
• Via partition arming — sensor breach only triggers an alarm after the partition is armed. Best for burglary protection.
• Via partition arming — with entry/exit delay — as above, but sensor breach status is blocked during a configurable entry/exit delay. Best for entry/exit zones.

user.title: Add HA roller shutter
user.description:
Select a Satel roller shutter: its output pair (up/down) becomes one cover in Home Assistant with open / close / stop.

Plain switchable outputs and read-only outputs are not created here — your Satel base integration (satel_integra / ha_satel_integra_ext) already provides those. Satel Link Companion references them instead of duplicating.

user.title: Add HA master alarm panel
user.description:
One (HomeKit compatible) master alarm panel that arms and disarms several Satel Integra partitions as a single unit. It uses the default code from satel_integra / ha_satel_integra_ext or HomeKit for arming.

For each (HomeKit-compatible) mode, enter the Satel partitions, comma-separated, in arm order. Available partitions: {partitions}.

• Home → alarm_arm_home (the Satel mode follows your arm_home_mode setting)
• Away → alarm_arm_away
• Night → alarm_arm_night

Leave a mode empty to not offer it. 'Off' disarms every partition used, in numeric order.
